lines.text: A dispute arose among the disciples about which was the greatest, and Jesus said the leader should be like the one who serves.
Jesus said His Father bestowed a kingdom on Him, so the disciples would eat at His altar and judge the twelve tribes.
Jesus told Simon that Satan had asked to sift the disciples like wheat, and that He had prayed Simon's faith would not fail.
Peter said he was ready to go with Jesus to prison and death, but Jesus said he would deny Him three times.
Jesus told them to buy a sword, and when they showed Him two swords, He said that is enough.
